<b>Pollip Hearts</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
6 Pollip Hearts are required to complete the <i>[[Rite of the Pollip]]</i> Wish, given by [[Greyroot]] in [[Shellwood]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Greyroot.png!Location in Shellwood
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Greyroot 02.png!Greyroot in Shellwood
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Purple flowers called Pollips can be found growing around Shellwood, some of which sprout large buds that can be destroyed to drop a single Pollip Heart.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Pollip Heart.png!Locations of the Pollip Hearts
}}

|Image6 = Screenshot SS Pollip Heart 06.png!Pollip Heart northeast of the Weaver Burial Spire
}}

== Trivia ==
* Pollip Hearts share the same sprite as [[Mossberry|Mossberries]] for when the item has not been picked up. This base sprite is not coloured, instead being given its in-game appearance by post-processing effects or a shader.

|Image1 = Screenshot SS Pollip Heart 07.png!Pollip Heart item
